title: Directory
description: Directory event log wire contract (ticket 26/08/16/HUB-SPACES-LIVE-PRESENCE-AND-COLLABORATIVE-STUDIOS, contract C1): the hub's control-plane events, the client-issued commands that produce them, the `/directory/socket/v1` stream envelope, and the REST read DTOs.
$comment: 🧭️ Deviation from contract-freeze.md's C1 prose: `space.created`'s space-kind field and `create-space`'s space-kind field are named `spaceKind`, not the prose's bare `kind` — both bodies are internally tagged (`#[serde(tag = "kind")]`) so a same-named payload field would collide with the discriminator on the wire. Flagged as a sharedFileRequest in lane 0-A's report for the coordinator to fold back into contract-freeze.md.

spaceKind.x-semio-note: the space's own kind (atelier/studio/archive) — named `spaceKind` rather than the contract prose's bare `kind` because this variant is internally tagged with a discriminator ALSO named `kind` (see the schema's own header docstring)

kind.description: Atomically freezes the space and demotes every current Author membership to Spectator.

requestId.x-semio-note: idempotency correlation only — never a capability

inviteToken.x-semio-note: one-shot capability; never persisted, broadcast, folded, or logged

InviteCapabilityTransferStateV1.description: 🎟️ Every state a directory invite-capability transfer can hold.

InviteCapabilityTransferInputV1.description: 🎟️ Every input the invite-capability transfer machine accepts.

InviteCapabilityTransferTransitionV1.description: 🎟️ One transition of the invite-capability transfer machine. `discloses` marks the only transitions that expose the token to the clipboard; `erases` marks the transitions that drop it.

InviteCapabilityDisclosureAuthorityV1.description: 🔐️ The space roles allowed to see an invite token. Spectators never are.

InviteCapabilityFocusPhaseV1.description: 🎯️ Terminal phases the administration pane returns focus on.

DirectoryAdministrationRouteV1.description: 🚪️ The shell route an invite transfer is opened through. `operationEpoch` fences a route against a stale reply.

InviteCapabilityCopyV1.description: 🈯️ Clipboard status copy for one locale, in transfer-state order: available, copying, failed.

InviteCapabilityLabelsV1.description: 🈯️ Invite transfer copy per locale. English and German are both required — the directory pane has no default language.

InviteCapabilityTransferV1.description: 🎟️ The language-neutral invite-capability transfer machine for the directory administration pane: one outstanding transfer at a time, disclosure only to the author, and a duplicate request rejected without ever disclosing the token again.

ArtifactCreationProgressCopyV1.description: 🈯️ Artifact-creation progress copy for one locale: the heading, the cancel affordance, and one line per progress and catalog phase.

ArtifactCreationProgressLocalesV1.description: 🈯️ Artifact-creation progress copy keyed by locale. English and German are both required — the shell has no default language.

ArtifactCreationProgressCaseV1.description: 🌱️ One rendered artifact-creation progress state: which phase it is in, whether cancellation was already requested, and the accessibility role, liveness, cancellability and opening it projects.

ArtifactCreationCatalogCaseV1.description: 🗂️ One rendered artifact-kind catalog state and the accessibility role and liveness it projects.

ArtifactCreationProgressUiV1.description: 🌱️ The language-neutral artifact-creation progress surface: bilingual copy plus the exact accessibility projection of every progress and catalog phase.

DirectoryProjectionReceiptV1.description: 📇️ The receipt a directory projection publishes once, terminally, after a bootstrap handshake. `authorizationGeneration` fences a receipt against a rotated authorization; `throughSeqInclusive` is the last event page it covers.

DirectoryHomeIdentityV1.description: 🪪️ The identity a directory home session is opened for. Neither field may start or end with a space, or carry a control character.

DirectoryHomeBootstrapStepV1.description: 📇️ One step of the directory home bootstrap lifecycle: the action the shell took and the outcome the owner settled on.

DirectoryHomeBootstrapLabelsV1.description: 🈯️ Directory home bootstrap status copy per locale. English and German are both required — the shell has no default language.
